accountingSchemes.title: Accounting Schemes
accountingSchemes.emptyDescription: Bind a journal template's symbolic account role (e.g. CASH) to a real GL account for a given currency.
accountingSchemes.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the binding and cannot be undone.

financialPeriods.title: Financial Periods
financialPeriods.emptyDescription: Every journal entry posts against the period covering its transaction date.
financialPeriods.closePeriodConfirmDescription: Once closed, no new journal entries can be posted or reversed against this period. This cannot be undone.
financialPeriods.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the period and cannot be undone.

generalLedger.title: General Ledger
generalLedger.description: Balances and posted activity for a single GL account within a financial period.
generalLedger.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected period.
generalLedger.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a GL account and a financial period above to view its ledger.

generalLedger.title: General Ledger
generalLedger.description: Every account's opening, period and closing balances for a financial period.
generalLedger.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view every account's balances.

journalReport.title: Journal Report
journalReport.description: Journal entries filtered by date, branch, status and transaction type.

journalEntryDetails.title: Journal Entry Details
journalEntryDetails.description: Look up a single journal entry by its entry number to view its full detail.
journalEntryDetails.notFound: No journal entry found with that entry number.

ledgerByBranch.title: Ledger by Branch
ledgerByBranch.description: Posted journal activity across every GL account for a single branch.
ledgerByBranch.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a branch above to view its posted activity. Optionally narrow it to a date range.
ledgerByBranch.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This branch has no posted journal entries in the selected range.

ledgerByDateRange.title: Ledger by Date Range
ledgerByDateRange.description: A GL account's balances and posted activity for a custom date range.
ledgerByDateRange.dateRangeRequired: Select both a from and to date to view this account's ledger.
ledgerByDateRange.emptyTitlePick: Pick an account and date range
ledgerByDateRange.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a GL account and a date range above to view its ledger.
ledgerByDateRange.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected range.

accountTransactionHistory.title: Account Transaction History
accountTransactionHistory.description: The full posted transaction trail for a GL account, optionally narrowed to a date range.
accountTransactionHistory.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a GL account above to view its transaction history.
accountTransactionHistory.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries yet.

glAccounts.title: Chart of Accounts
glAccounts.emptyDescription: Set up the chart of accounts that journal entries post against.
glAccounts.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the account and cannot be undone. Accounts with child accounts cannot be deleted.

fields.parentAccountHint: Leave blank for a top-level account

journalEntries.title: Journal Entries
journalEntries.emptyDescription: Record a journal entry to start tracking the general ledger.
journalEntries.validationMissingFields: Please fill in the transaction type, date, branch and currency.

fields.referenceHint: Opaque pointer back to the upstream event, e.g. a loan id

journalTemplates.title: Journal Templates
journalTemplates.emptyDescription: Define the debit/credit legs that fire for a transaction type — e.g. every DISBURSEMENT debits Loan Receivable and credits Cash.
journalTemplates.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the template and its lines and cannot be undone.

fields.name: Name
fields.rolesHint: Roles are symbolic (e.g. CASH, LOAN_RECEIVABLE) — an accounting scheme binds each one to a real GL account per currency.

trialBalance.title: Trial Balance
trialBalance.description: Posted debit/credit totals per GL account for a financial period.
trialBalance.periodOnlyNote: This period's activity only — no carryforward from prior periods. Generate a snapshot below for the cumulative, ending-balance view.
trialBalance.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.
trialBalance.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its trial balance.
trialBalance.snapshotsEmptyDescriptionNoActivity: Generate a snapshot to freeze this period for audit purposes.
trialBalance.snapshotsEmptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to see its snapshots.

adjustedTrialBalance.title: Adjusted Trial Balance
adjustedTrialBalance.description: Debit/credit totals per GL account reflecting every posted journal entry for a period, including adjustments.
adjustedTrialBalance.note: This system does not track adjusting entries separately from regular postings — this report reflects every entry posted for the period.
adjustedTrialBalance.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its adjusted trial balance.
adjustedTrialBalance.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.

closingTrialBalance.title: Closing Trial Balance
closingTrialBalance.description: The most recent persisted snapshot for a period — rolled-forward closing balances.
closingTrialBalance.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its closing trial balance.
closingTrialBalance.emptyDescriptionNoSnapshot: Generate a snapshot for this period on the Trial Balance page to see its closing balances here.

balanceSheet.title: Balance Sheet
balanceSheet.description: Assets, liabilities and equity as of a financial period's end.
balanceSheet.retainedEarningsNote: Computed from cumulative income and expense activity — this system has no period-close process that posts net income into a retained earnings account, so this line is calculated rather than read from the ledger.
balanceSheet.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its balance sheet.
balanceSheet.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No accounts have posted journal entries as of the selected period.

incomeStatement.title: Income Statement
incomeStatement.description: Income and expenses for a financial period (Profit & Loss).
incomeStatement.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its income statement.
incomeStatement.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No income or expense accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.

cashFlow.title: Cash Flow Statement
cashFlow.description: Cash account movements for a date range, grouped by transaction type.
cashFlow.cashAccountPlaceholder: Select the GL account representing cash
cashFlow.note: This is a simplified cash movement summary grouped by transaction type — this system doesn't classify postings into operating, investing or financing activities, so it isn't a formal 3-category cash flow statement.
cashFlow.emptyTitlePick: Pick a cash account and date range
cashFlow.emptyDescriptionPick: Select the GL account representing cash and a date range above.
cashFlow.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected range.

changesInEquity.title: Statement of Changes in Equity
changesInEquity.description: Opening and closing balances for each equity account over a financial period.
changesInEquity.netIncomeReference: Net income for the period (reference — not included in the equity movements below)
changesInEquity.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view changes in equity.
changesInEquity.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No equity accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.
